title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
title_zh: SuperMotion：面向文本驱动人体动作编辑的源保留去噪

paragraphs.en: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion) , which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.
paragraphs.zh: 基于文本的人类动作编辑旨在实现所需更改，同时保留兼容的原始内容。 现有的扩散编辑器在很大程度上依赖学习到的条件来保留未编辑部分，但其输出在去噪过程中可能会丢失时间细节。 我们提出了源保留去噪框架（SuperMotion），该框架在每个反向步骤中显式地重新利用原始动作以实现源保留。 我们首先将原始动作与输出时间线对齐，并预测一个保留门控，用于控制跨帧和特征维度的重复利用。 随后，一个干净空间源锚点利用学习到的保留门控，将预测的干净动作与对齐后的原始动作混合，并将修正后的估计值直接传递给采样后验。 由于对齐后的原始动作是一个已实现的运动，而非回归输出，该锚点注入了样本级别的时间细节，而这些细节通常会被训练用于重建的去噪器平滑掉。 为了学习有效的源重复利用方法，我们将锚定估计值与编辑目标进行监督，并通过时间高频损失匹配其二阶时间差异。 这些目标不需要显式的编辑掩码。 广泛的实验表明，SuperMotion提高了编辑准确性，在MotionFix上达到了33.20%的全池R@1，同时减少了时间细节的衰减并保留了动作动态，从而实现了所需更改。 消融研究证实，学习到的保留门控是性能提升的关键，并且它通过重复利用原始动作来正确保留未编辑内容。

paragraphs.en: Text-driven human motion editing modifies an existing movement according to a textual instruction. A request such as “straighten knees” specifies a change while preserving other aspects of the source movement (Figure 1 ). A successful edit must therefore balance instruction compliance with preservation of compatible source content. This balance requires more than copying a predefined region. Source and reference target motions may differ in duration, coordination, and execution, so content that should be retained cannot be preserved exactly, but only approximately. The editor must determine how to use the source while accommodating the requested change.
paragraphs.zh: 基于文本的人类动作编辑会根据文本指令修改现有的动作。 像“伸直膝盖”这样的请求会指定一项改动，同时保留源动作的其他方面（图 1）。 因此，一次成功的编辑必须在遵循指令与保留兼容的源内容之间取得平衡。 这种平衡需要的不仅仅是复制一个预定义的区域。 源动作和参考目标动作可能在持续时间、协调性和执行方式上存在差异，因此应当保留的内容无法被完全保留，而只能近似保留。 编辑器必须决定如何运用源动作，同时实现所请求的改动。

paragraphs.en: Advances in text-conditioned motion generation provide a foundation for motion editing ( Petrovich et al., 2022 ; Tevet et al., 2022b ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . Existing editors build on these models by improving how they use the source motion and instruction, learning motion similarity, and introducing objectives for editing body parts and preserving source content ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . These methods can produce the requested action, but the resulting movement may be too subdued or too exaggerated compared with the reference target. Retrieval scores measure how well the generated motion matches the target in a learned representation, but do not directly measure these differences in movement. We therefore examine how temporal detail changes in the generated motion and throughout denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 文本条件运动生成领域的进步为运动编辑奠定了基础（Petrovich 等人，2022；Tevet 等人，2022b；Zhang 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2024）。 现有的编辑器基于这些模型进行改进，通过优化源运动和指令的使用方式、学习运动相似性，以及引入针对身体部位编辑和保留源内容的目标来实现（Athanasiou 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025；Guo 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2025；Shi 等人，2026）。 这些方法能够生成所需的动作，但与参考目标相比，生成的运动可能过于平缓或过于夸张。 检索分数衡量的是生成的运动在已学习的表示空间中与目标匹配的程度，但并未直接衡量这些运动差异。 因此，我们研究了生成运动中时间细节的变化以及去噪过程中这些细节的演变情况。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, we define a detail ratio : the magnitude of second-order temporal differences of the running clean-motion estimate x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} at a given reverse step, normalized by the same statistic computed on the ground-truth target. A well-calibrated reverse process should drive this ratio toward 1 × 1\times and hold it there. Figure 2 shows that prior diffusion editors behave otherwise: the median ratio decreases along the reverse trajectory, crosses 1 × 1\times , and keeps falling, reaching 0.33 × 0.33\times for TMED ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) , 0.66 × 0.66\times for OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , and 0.71 × 0.71\times for SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) . The decline concentrates in the final low-noise steps, where the estimate already matches the target detail level and further denoising suppresses local temporal variation instead of refining it. A denoiser trained with a reconstruction objective approximates a posterior mean ( Efron, 2011 ) , and such distortion-optimal estimates are necessarily smoother than individual samples ( Blau and Michaeli, 2018 ) . The effect is especially costly in motion editing. The content that should be preserved already exists in the source, but regenerating the sequence from noise forces the model to resynthesize it, after which it is pulled toward the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们定义一个细节比率：在给定反向步骤中，运行中的干净运动估计值 x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} 的二阶时间差异的幅度，经与在真实目标上计算的相同统计量归一化得到。 一个经过良好校准的反向过程应将此比率推向 1 × 1\times 并保持在该水平。 图 2 显示，先前的扩散编辑器表现不同：该比率的中间值沿反向轨迹下降，穿过 1 × 1\times 并持续降低，对于 TMED（Athanasiou et al., 2024）达到 0.33 × 0.33\times，对于 OmniME（Shi et al., 2026）达到 0.66 × 0.66\times，对于 SimMotionEdit（Li et al., 2025）达到 0.71 × 0.71\times。 这种下降主要集中在最后几个低噪声步骤中，此时估计值已经匹配了目标的细节水平，而进一步的降噪会抑制局部时间变化，而非对其进行优化。 使用重建目标训练的降噪器近似于后验均值（Efron, 2011），而这种失真最优的估计值必然比单个样本更平滑（Blau and Michaeli, 2018）。 这种影响在运动编辑中尤为代价高昂。 需要保留的内容已经存在于源数据中，但从噪声重新生成序列会迫使模型重新合成它，之后该序列会被拉向均值。

paragraphs.en: These observations motivate explicit control over source reuse during denoising. In frameworks that reconstruct the target from noise, source conditioning provides information about the input motion, but retaining its content still depends on the denoiser’s predictions ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The source could also provide a clean signal against which those predictions are adjusted at each reverse step. Related ideas appear in diffusion-based image editing and inpainting, where spatial masks or known regions guide the preservation of existing content ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Couairon et al., 2022 ) . Applying this principle to motion editing requires accounting for differences between the source and target sequences. Because no preservation mask is supplied, the model must learn how strongly to reuse the aligned source while allowing the instruction to change the movement.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们在去噪过程中对源数据的重复使用进行显式控制。 在从噪声中重建目标的框架中，源条件提供了关于输入运动的信息，但保留其内容仍然取决于去噪器的预测（Athanasiou 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025）。 源数据还可以提供一个干净的信号，用于在每个反向步骤中调整这些预测。 相关的思想也出现在基于扩散的图像编辑和修复中，其中空间掩码或已知区域指导了现有内容的保留（Avrahami 等人，2022；Lugmayr 等人，2022；Couairon 等人，2022）。 将此原则应用于运动编辑时，需要考虑源序列和目标序列之间的差异。 由于没有提供保留掩码，模型必须学习如何强烈地重复使用对齐的源数据，同时允许指令改变运动方式。

paragraphs.en: We introduce the S o u rce- P res er ving Denoising framework (SuperMotion) to learn this balance within the reverse process. Its central component, a Clean-Space Source Anchor , blends the current clean-motion estimate with a temporally aligned source through a learned Source Preservation Gate . The gate assigns a reuse weight to each frame and feature dimension at each denoising step. Applied after classifier-free guidance and clean-motion reconstruction, the anchor produces the estimate used directly by the sampling posterior. This placement gives the gate a consistent interpretation as a convex blending weight and avoids the inverse noise-scale factor required to express the same clean-motion correction in velocity space. Supervision against the editing target trains the gate to adjust source reuse without an explicit edit mask. We train SuperMotion with a source-anchor loss that learns source reuse from the editing target and a temporal high-frequency loss that matches second temporal differences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了源保留去噪框架（SuperMotion），用于在反向过程中学习这种平衡。 其核心组件是“纯净空间源锚点”，它通过一个经过学习的源保留门控机制，将当前的纯净运动估计值与时间对齐的源数据融合。 该门控机制在每次去噪步骤中为每一帧和每个特征维度分配一个重用权重。 该锚点应用于无分类器引导和纯净运动重建之后，生成的估计值可直接被采样后验分布使用。 这种设计使门控机制能够被一致地解释为一个凸混合权重，并避免了在速度空间中表达相同纯净运动修正所需的反向噪声尺度因子。 通过与编辑目标进行监督训练，门控机制能够无需显式编辑掩码即可调整源数据的重用程度。 我们通过源锚点损失（从编辑目标中学习源数据重用）和时间高频损失（匹配二阶时间差异）来训练 SuperMotion。

paragraphs.en: Human Motion Generation. Text-driven human motion generation has progressed through continuous latent modeling, diffusion-based synthesis, and discrete motion modeling. Guo et al. ( Guo et al., 2022 ) investigate diverse text-conditioned motion synthesis and introduce HumanML3D, supporting subsequent advances in language-driven animation. TEMOS ( Petrovich et al., 2022 ) learns compatible text and motion distributions through variational training, while MotionCLIP ( Tevet et al., 2022a ) aligns motion representations with the CLIP embedding space. Diffusion-based methods, including MDM ( Tevet et al., 2022b ) , MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and FLAME ( Kim et al., 2023 ) , generate motions through text-conditioned iterative denoising. MLD ( Chen et al., 2023 ) instead performs diffusion in a compact latent space to reduce computational cost. Discrete motion representations provide an alternative to continuous-space generation. T2M-GPT ( Zhang et al., 2023a ) combines vector quantization with autoregressive token prediction, while MotionGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) models motion and language within a unified token-based framework. MoMask ( Guo et al., 2024 ) and MMM ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2024 ) adopt masked motion modeling, enabling iterative token reconstruction and flexible generation. Beyond global text conditioning, FineMoGen ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) introduces fine-grained spatio-temporal control, and MaskControl ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2025 ) incorporates spatial constraints into masked motion generation. Together, these approaches improve the diversity, efficiency, and controllability of human motion synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Human Motion Editing. Human motion editing modifies an existing sequence while retaining content compatible with the requested change. Early generative approaches enable editing through semantic latent manipulation or constrained reconstruction. MotionCLIP ( Tevet et al., 2022a ) supports editing in a language-aligned latent space, while MDM ( Tevet et al., 2022b ) and FLAME ( Kim et al., 2023 ) support motion completion and editing through constrained diffusion. MMM ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2024 ) reconstructs masked motion tokens, and FineMoGen ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) supports fine-grained editing through spatio-temporal descriptions. These approaches establish useful editing capabilities, although their control interfaces and supervision differ from paired instruction-based editing. MotionFix ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) establishes a benchmark of source–instruction–target triplets and introduces a source-conditioned diffusion editor. Subsequent work improves instruction alignment, motion preservation, and editing versatility. SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) jointly trains motion editing and motion-similarity prediction, while PartMotionEdit ( Yang et al., 2025 ) combines part-aware modulation with part-level similarity supervision and bidirectional text–motion interaction. MotionReFit ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) expands editing supervision through MotionCutMix and uses an autoregressive diffusion model with a motion coordinator. MotionLab ( Guo et al., 2025 ) unifies generation and editing through a motion–condition–motion formulation based on rectified flows. OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) combines intermediate-feature, preservation, and positive–negative semantic supervision. Recent work further considers both spatial preservation and temporal rhythm through non-uniform temporal alignment ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人类动作编辑。 人类动作编辑在修改现有动作序列的同时，保留与所请求变更兼容的内容。 早期的生成方法通过语义潜在空间操控或约束重建来实现编辑。 MotionCLIP（Tevet 等，2022a）支持在语言对齐的潜在空间中执行编辑，而 MDM（Tevet 等，2022b）和 FLAME（Kim 等，2023）则通过约束扩散实现动作补全和编辑。 MMM（Pinyoanuntapong 等，2024）可重建被掩码的动作标记，而 FineMoGen（Zhang 等，2023b）则通过时空描述支持精细编辑。 这些方法建立了实用的编辑能力，尽管其控制接口和监督方式与基于配对指令的编辑有所不同。 MotionFix（Athanasiou 等，2024）建立了一个由源–指令–目标三元组组成的基准，并引入了一种以源为条件的扩散编辑器。 后续研究改进了指令对齐、动作保留和编辑的灵活性。 SimMotionEdit（Li 等，2025）联合训练了动作编辑与动作相似性预测，而 PartMotionEdit（Yang 等，2025）则将部件感知调制与部件级相似性监督及双向文本–动作交互相结合。 MotionReFit（Jiang 等，2025）通过 MotionCutMix 扩展了编辑的监督范围，并使用了一种带有动作协调器的自回归扩散模型。 MotionLab（Guo 等，2025）基于修正流，通过“动作–条件–动作”的公式统一了生成与编辑。 OmniME（Shi 等，2026）结合了中间特征监督、动作保留监督以及正负样本语义监督。 近期的研究进一步通过非均匀时间对齐（Lin 等，2026），同时考虑了空间保留与时间节奏。

Over the remaining frames and coordinates the target coincides with the source, so the underlying edit is close to an identity mapping. Diffusion editors nevertheless regenerate the full sequence from Gaussian noise with s s and c c used only as conditions, so every reverse step re-synthesizes coordinates that could have been copied. A denoiser trained with a reconstruction loss approximates the posterior mean 𝔼 ⁡ [ x 0 ∣ x t ] \mathbb{E}[x_{0}\mid x_{t}] , and such distortion-optimal estimates are smoother than any individual sample ( Blau and Michaeli, 2018 ) . The sigmoid gate takes values in (0, 1), so it approaches an optimum at 0 0 or 1 1 without reaching it. The unclipped ratio is the fraction of the way from the denoiser prediction to the source at which the target lies. It equals one where the target coincides with the source and zero where it coincides with the prediction. The bound ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) is a design choice and we ablate other choices in Sec. 4.3 . Where the target lies outside the segment between prediction and source, the gate saturates and the residual is left to the denoiser. paragraphs.en: We build on SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) , using a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder and a 207-dimensional motion representation at 30 fps. We initialize SuperMotion from the trained backbone and jointly train the denoiser and preservation head using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 128 on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. We use velocity prediction with a squared-cosine noise schedule and 300 diffusion steps. At inference, both source and text guidance scales are set to 3.0, and source anchoring is applied after guidance at every reverse step.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Table 2 report quantitative comparisons. On MotionFix, our method ranks first on seven of eight metrics, with OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) marginally ahead on FR@3 . A more informative reference is the copy source baseline, which returns the input unchanged and still reaches 74.79 % 74.79\% BR@1 . Most prior editors fall below it, indicating that regenerating the target from noise destroys more source content than the edit itself introduces. Only OmniME and our method exceed this baseline, and ours does so by the larger margin on both batch ( + 4.38 +4.38 ) and full-pool ( + 2.96 +2.96 ) R@1. On STANCE Adjustment, our method leads all batch-retrieval metrics and improves full-pool AvgR from 22.77 22.77 to 19.21 19.21 . FR@1 is lower than OmniME, while FR@3 is higher and full-pool AvgR is lower, indicating fewer severe ranking failures rather than more top-1 matches. Across the two benchmarks, SuperMotion is the only method that exceeds the copy-source baseline on every retrieval metric on both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 和表 2 报告了定量比较结果。 在 MotionFix 数据集上，我们的方法在八项指标中排名第七，其中 OmniME（Shi 等人，2026）在 FR@3 指标上略胜一筹。 更具参考价值的基准是复制源基线，该方法直接返回原始输入，其 BR@1 仍能达到 74.79%（74.79\%）。 大多数先前的编辑器方法表现低于该基线，这表明从噪声中再生目标内容所破坏的源内容比编辑本身引入的变化更多。 只有 OmniME 和我们的方法超过了这一基线，且我们的方法在批量（+4.38）和全池（+2.96）R@1 指标上均取得了更大的领先优势。 在 STANCE Adjustment 数据集上，我们的方法在所有批量检索指标中表现最佳，并将全池 AvgR 从 22.77 提升至 19.21。 FR@1 低于 OmniME，而 FR@3 更高且全池 AvgR 更低，这表明排名失败的情况较少，而非前 1 名匹配结果更多。 在这两个基准测试中，SuperMotion 是唯一一种在两个基准的所有检索指标上均超越复制源基线的方法。

paragraphs.en: Equation 7 says the optimal gate should behave in two ways: it should be smaller when the edit is larger, and it should go to zero at the end of denoising. paragraphs.en: In this work, we analyze the denoising process of existing methods and identify the temporal-detail attenuation as a systematic failure of diffusion motion editors. We propose Source-Preserving Denoising, which makes source reuse an explicit operation at every reverse step by blending the clean-motion estimate toward the aligned source through a learned per-frame, per-dimension gate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SuperMotion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art editors on both MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment. Ablations attribute the improvement to the learned preservation gate, which enables selective source reuse and preserves high-frequency temporal detail that competing methods attenuate.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们分析了现有方法的去噪过程，并指出时间细节的衰减是扩散运动编辑器的一种系统性缺陷。 我们提出了源保留去噪方法（Source-Preserving Denoising），该方法通过一个每帧、每维度学习的门控机制，将干净的运动估计值与对齐后的源数据融合，从而在每一步反向操作中显式地实现源数据重用。 大量实验表明，SuperMotion 在 MotionFix 和 STANCE Adjustment 两项任务上均持续优于当前最先进的编辑器。 消融实验表明，性能提升源于所学习的保留门控机制，它实现了选择性的源数据重用，并保留了其他方法会衰减的高频时间细节。

sents.en: In this work, we analyze the denoising process of existing methods and identify the temporal-detail attenuation as a systematic failure of diffusion motion editors.
sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们分析了现有方法的去噪过程，并指出时间细节的衰减是扩散运动编辑器的一种系统性缺陷。

sents.en: We propose Source-Preserving Denoising, which makes source reuse an explicit operation at every reverse step by blending the clean-motion estimate toward the aligned source through a learned per-frame, per-dimension gate.
sents.zh: 我们提出了源保留去噪方法（Source-Preserving Denoising），该方法通过一个每帧、每维度学习的门控机制，将干净的运动估计值与对齐后的源数据融合，从而在每一步反向操作中显式地实现源数据重用。

sents.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SuperMotion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art editors on both MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment.
sents.zh: 大量实验表明，SuperMotion 在 MotionFix 和 STANCE Adjustment 两项任务上均持续优于当前最先进的编辑器。

sents.en: Ablations attribute the improvement to the learned preservation gate, which enables selective source reuse and preserves high-frequency temporal detail that competing methods attenuate.
sents.zh: 消融实验表明，性能提升源于所学习的保留门控机制，它实现了选择性的源数据重用，并保留了其他方法会衰减的高频时间细节。

paragraphs.en: The generation loader writes 836 sequences, consisting of a random half of the official test split (506 examples) and the 330 validation examples. The TMR gallery ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) is the evaluator’s test set, so full-pool metrics rank each query against the 506-id test pool , not against all 836 generated files. Validation outputs never enter that gallery. Batch retrieval sorts the same IDs, shuffles them, and forms disjoint batches of 32, leaving 26 examples unused (480 scored queries). A batch percentage is therefore not a statistic over all 506 examples.
paragraphs.zh: 生成加载器会写入 836 个序列，其中包括官方测试集随机抽取的一半（506 个样本）以及 330 个验证样本。 TMR 图库（Athanasiou 等，2024）是评估者的测试集，因此全池指标会将每个查询与包含 506 个 ID 的测试池进行比较，而不是与全部 836 个生成的文件进行比较。 验证输出绝不会进入该图库。 批量检索会对相同的 ID 进行排序、打乱，并组成互不重叠的 32 个样本批次，剩余 26 个样本未被使用（共 480 个评分查询）。 因此，批量百分比并非基于全部 506 个样本的统计量。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows results on STANCE Adjustment, where each instruction targets a specific limb or side. In the lower body runs to the other side , the baselines introduce a full-body reorientation or an airborne pose absent from the source, while our result redirects the lower body alone. In raise the other leg upward and bend the other arm , the baselines frequently act on the wrong limb or apply the change to both sides. Our method selects the intended one and leaves the remaining joints close to the source.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了 STANCE Adjustment 的结果，其中每条指令都针对特定的肢体或身体一侧。 在下肢向另一侧移动的任务中，基线方法会引入源数据中没有的全身重新定向或空中姿态，而我们的结果仅重新定向下肢。 在“抬起另一条腿并弯曲另一只手臂”的任务中，基线方法经常作用于错误的肢体，或者将变化同时应用于两侧。 我们的方法会选择目标肢体，并将其余关节保持与源数据接近的状态。
